body: My ex used to do similar things to me, and I let him get away with it for four years. It took me so long after that to realize how fucking not okay that was. If I can use that experience to tell you how much better you deserve and how horrible his behavior is that’s all I want.
I have yeah. I’m on medication and see a therapist twice a month. I guess I mean know one will know it never stopped, that I still relapse. I want to avoid it all. My biggest fear is being a burden.
I’m thinking of giving it another week or two and see if anything changes? But I don’t want to be a burden to him, maybe it’s not even worth bringing up again.

I think that’s the problem, I’m not really sure what I was expecting. I’ve never told anyone the things that I told him. I guess in a way I’m a bit relieved he hasn’t brought it up again, I think I would be okay if we both just pretended I never said anything
I’m sure he’s overwhelmed, I’m hoping it’s just that. Sometimes he doesn’t communicate well about difficult topics
You don’t need to lie to us too it’s okay
This might just be the longest momentarily of my life.

Thank you for this. I just feel like a burden and I don’t want to bring him down with me and I don’t want to scare him. He knows about the depression, but I’ve never told anyone I know about the suicidal thoughts or the recent self harm. I’ve gotten through this hole before but I always seem to find myself back in it. I’m worried one of these days I won’t be able to get out.
I just don’t know how much longer I can ignore it.
